name: Red White Cinderella 2
source:
After returning from Motherland, it's time for Claude and Lee to adapt to your world. Unfortunately, your 'happy ever after' must wait as Motherland needs your help! Prepare yourself! How much are you willing to sacrifice?

[From in-app]
translation:
从故乡归来后，该轮到Claude和Lee适应你的世界了。可惜，你们的“从此过上幸福快乐的生活”还得再等等，因为故乡需要你们帮忙！做好准备吧！你愿意为此付出多少？

[来源：游戏内]
